tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground — the cream of a tweed amp. Most of every screen stays this colour (間, ma).

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Sunken ground: table heads, skeletons, input hover, card fills.

tokens.name: paper-3
tokens.usage: Raised ground for overlays only (modal, menu, popover, toast), always with a 1px `ink` border and `shadow-block`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on every `paper`; solid button fill and hover inversion. Lines use `rule`, not `ink`.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `paper` and `paper-2`: hints, captions, meta, inactive tabs.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Disabled text and borders only — below 4.5:1 by design.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Every structural line: control borders, card and sheet frames, table rules, dividers. Softer than `ink` so hairlines read finer; ≥ 6.8:1 on every `paper`, so control boundaries stay well above 3:1.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Inner dividers inside an ink frame (table rows). Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `ink` fills (solid buttons, hover inversion, tooltips, active pagination).

tokens.name: olivo
tokens.usage: The brand colour — Fender olive, Pantone 18-0527 TCX Olive Branch (approx.). Focus ring, active markers (dots, tab edge, nav underline), accent button, progress fill, accent figures. Text-safe on `paper` in both themes. On `paper-2` it holds 4.2:1 — use it there for marks, figures 24px+ and bold labels, not small body text.

tokens.name: on-olivo
tokens.usage: Text on `olivo` fills.

tokens.name: maple
tokens.usage: Amber of a maple neck. FILL ONLY, always with `ink` text (`on-maple`): the accent badge, the leading progress segment, cover blocks, text selection. Never text, never a border that carries meaning, never a status.

tokens.name: on-maple
tokens.usage: Text on `maple` fills.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: Info status: text and 1px borders on `paper`, always with the word or ⓘ glyph.

tokens.name: matsu
tokens.usage: Success status: text and borders on `paper`, always with the word or ✓. Bluer than `olivo` so it never reads as the brand.

tokens.name: kitsune
tokens.usage: Warning status: text and borders on `paper`, always with the word or !. Darker and browner than `maple`; `maple` is never used for status.

tokens.name: beni
tokens.usage: Danger and validation errors, always with the word or ×. The only red in the system.

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: Text on solid `ai`, `matsu`, `kitsune` or `beni` fills.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind Modal and Offcanvas.

tokens.name: scanline
tokens.usage: Line colour of the `.ol-scanlines` texture over an `ink` block. Decoration only.

families.jp: "Zen Old Mincho", "Hiragino Mincho ProN", "Yu Mincho", serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Redaction. One per page: hero names, section openers. Two lines at most.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Redaction. Page titles. Two lines at most.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Redaction. Headings inside content. Italic for one emphasised word.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Accordion rows, alert titles, list item titles.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: Sprat Condensed Black — numbers only. Oversized index numerals and hero figures.

styles.name: figure-m
styles.usage: Counters inside components: carousel, pagination, tab indexes. Never below 16px.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: El espacio no está vacío; es la forma de lo que hay.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Cada control es una caja con una línea de tinta.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Martian Mono, UPPERCASE: labels, buttons, badges, tabs, eyebrows, meta. The voice of the interface.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Code, data values, timestamps, numeric table columns.

styles.name: kanji
styles.usage: Zen Old Mincho, a calm serif kanji that pairs with Redaction. Ornament with meaning, never the only label. Vertical along titles.

spacing.note: 4px base. The large steps are the point: leave space-16 and up empty around anything important.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside compact controls, label-to-input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding inline (small), list row padding block.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding inline (default), card inner gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and modal padding, gutters of the 12-column grid.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between related groups.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page margins on desktop; space above a display title.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between page-level sections.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Ma — deliberate emptiness around a hero or a single statement.

radius.note: Square by default. Circles are reserved for things that are literally points.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Every box: buttons, inputs, cards, modals, badges, images.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Only the radio mark, the status dot and the switch knob.

stroke.note: Line weights. Lines are `rule` unless a status colours them. Hairlines are 0.5px on retina screens.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Default border of every control, card, table and rule. Renders as a true 0.5px hairline on high-density screens (the stylesheet overrides it at ≥ 2dppx) and 1px elsewhere.

tokens.name: stroke-bold
tokens.usage: Focus ring (in `olivo`, never thinner — accessibility), active tab edge, nav underline, selected list edge.

tokens.name: stroke-heavy
tokens.usage: Section rules above display titles and the footer rule; at most one per view.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between a focused element and its `stroke-bold` `olivo` focus ring.

tokens.name: control-s
tokens.usage: Small buttons and inputs, table toolbars.

tokens.name: control-m
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs, selects, nav items.

tokens.name: control-l
tokens.usage: Hero calls to action, search fields.

layout.note: Page layout. Breakpoints are min-widths; CSS media queries can't read custom properties, so stylesheets repeat these values and the tokens document them.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max width of `Container`; content centres inside it.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: large phones and up.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: tablets and up. Below it, a `Col` spans the full row unless it sets a `base` span.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: laptops and up.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: desktops; matches `container-max`.

shadow.note: No soft shadows. One hard, offset block shadow for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-block
tokens.usage: Modal, dropdown menu, popover, toast — anything above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Hover state of `Card` with `interactive`; removed on press.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Everything else.

texture.note: Pitches of the decorative textures. Decoration only, never behind body text.

tokens.name: halftone-pitch
tokens.usage: Dot pitch of `.ol-halftone`.

tokens.name: halftone-pitch-fine
tokens.usage: Dot pitch of `.ol-halftone--fine`.

tokens.name: scanline-pitch
tokens.usage: Repeat of `.ol-scanlines`: one line every pitch.

tokens.name: scanline-weight
tokens.usage: Thickness of each `.ol-scanlines` line.

tokens.name: crosshair-size
tokens.usage: Size of the `+` marks of `.ol-crosshair`.

tokens.name: dot-size
tokens.usage: The olive point of `Label dot`, the navbar's current-page dot and the toast meta dot.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, popovers.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky navbar.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Modal and offcanvas with their scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast stack.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips.
